task_instruction: Transcribe the speech verbatim exactly as spoken. Never insert, repeat, or add any word you do not clearly hear in the audio. Output only the transcript text.
what_this_is: configs/baseline/e21-units-obse1-scored7.json -- the OBS-E1 arm -- with ONE value changed: obs_unit_plan and its pin now name the v3 plan instead of the v2 one. Every other key is byte for byte OBS-E1's, which are themselves byte for byte the sealed SAEA-E21-FULL44-DIRECT-BASELINE-V2 comparator's plus the three OBS-E1 added. The instruction in particular is UNCHANGED, which is the whole reason the overlap protocol was chosen over the boundary-marker one: OBS-E1b asks the core exactly what OBS-E1 asked it, so the contrast against OBS-E1 has one factor -- the audio each contact carries -- and not two.
single_factor_against_obs_e1: the DELIVERED AUDIO. Plan v3 carries the same 5,122 turn spans as v2 (asserted field by field by the builder, receipt docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-08-e21-speaker-turn-units-v3/), and adds to each unit the bounds of the audio actually cut for it: the turn widened by a nominal 5.0 s on each side, floored at a 10.0 s delivered cut, capped at 90.0 s and clamped to the call. 141,345.853 turn seconds are unchanged; 49,968.499 context seconds are added; delivered audio is 201,558.352 s with the 2.0 s tails against OBS-E1's 151,589.853 s. Contacts do not move: 5,122 either way.
why_the_cap_is_90: obs_buffer_seconds stays 90 and is now the cap on the DELIVERED cut, not on the turn. reproduction.obs_loop._load_unit_plan already refuses any unit longer than it, and the slot receipt certified the 90-second window at 2.72x against the 6,144-token slot -- so no delivered cut can leave the certified slot and no re-certification is needed. The units that receive no context because of the cap are the >= 60 s ones, which the PERSON harm decomposition found were already BETTER in OBS-E1 than in the comparator.
text_ownership: saea-obs-context-ownership-v1 (reproduction.obs_ownership). The core transcribes the context too, so the run stitches each unit's OWN turn only: around every boundary both units received the same seconds, and the stitch cuts both texts at one position inside a run of words they agree on, where every position is gapless and duplication-free. Proved model-free on the sealed OBS-E1 texts before this fragment existed -- zero-margin identity exact on 44/44 calls, and 99.982 % of the corpus's words retained at this plan's own margin (docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-08-e21-obs-e1b-stitch-proof/). No forced aligner is used anywhere.
why_batch_slices_stays_8: obs_batch_slices 8 is OBS-E1's own value and is now also a REQUIREMENT: the ownership stitch resolves each boundary from both of its units' answers, which only the slice-parallel pass has in hand before it writes a record. ObsLoopConfig.from_values refuses a context-bearing plan at obs_batch_slices <= 1, fail-closed.
plan_pin_basis: obs_unit_plan_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the committed plan file and the seam refuses a plan whose bytes disagree with it. The plan is model-free (exposure row SAEA-E21-MF-SPEAKER-TURN-UNITS-V3): it opens no waveform at all, deriving from the committed v2 plan alone.
composing_is_not_permission: This fragment LOADS; OBS-E1b still needs its own exposure row and the owner's GO, and neither is granted by this file. OBS-E1 remains REJECTED.
